name: handover-standup
description: A chair goes round the team by name; each answers in turn and is thanked.
lines: Morning everyone, let's keep this quick because I know half of you have the planning session straight after this.
Okay, let's go round. Priya, you're up.
Thanks. Yesterday I finished the checkout screens, today I'm pairing with design on the empty states, and no blockers.
Still on the payments migration. I'm blocked on the sandbox keys from the provider, I chased them again this morning.
Okay, I'll escalate that after the call. Siobhan, anything from you?
Just that the interview loop for the two backend roles is booked for next week, so please keep Thursday afternoon free.
I can take one of the Thursday slots.
Lovely, thanks Imogen. Okay, that's everyone, see you at planning.
